title: ExecutionRecord
description: A single row in the execution history (`state_executions`). One record per extension execution (Action or finder Analyzer), whether an external agent drained the job (agent) or the extension ran in-process.

kind.description: Which extension kind was executed: `action`, or `analyzer` for a probabilistic finder drained through the queue (the audit kind was removed pre-1.0).

extensionId.description: Id of the extension that ran (e.g. `markdown-summarizer`).

extensionVersion.description: Semver of the extension implementation at execution time.

nodeIds.description: Target `node.path` values. Empty for whole-graph actions.

contentHash.description: Duplicate-prevention hash used at submit time: sha256 over the NUL-joined (0x00) tuple (extensionId, extensionVersion, node.path, bodyHash, frontmatterHash, promptTemplateHash). May be null for in-process actions that don't memoize.

status.description: Terminal status. History never stores `queued` or `running`, those live in `state_jobs` until they reach a terminal state.

failureReason.description: Normalized reason when `status = failed`. Null for `completed` and `cancelled` (both self-explanatory), mirroring `Job.failureReason`. `user-failed` records an operator-forced failure (`sm job fail`); a `cancelled` status is the operator's `sm job cancel` and carries no reason. `job-file-missing` mirrors the same enum value on `Job.failureReason` (legacy name preserved across the disk-to-DB shift).

exitCode.description: Exit code the recording agent reported for its execution, when it reports one. Null for in-process executions or when the agent reports none.

runner.description: Which execution path produced this record: an external agent via claim/record, or in-process deterministic code. Null when the action runs synchronously without dispatching.

durationMs.description: Finished - started. Stored denormalized for query speed.

tokensIn.description: Input tokens reported by the recording agent. Null if not applicable or not reported.

tokensOut.description: Output tokens reported by the runner.

reportPath.description: Legacy field preserved across the disk-to-DB shift. Under B2 (DB-only job artifacts) this is always null because reports live inline in `state_executions.report_json`. Phase A of Step 10 will rename to `report` (object/null) carrying the parsed payload; until then the field remains as documented for backward compat.

jobId.description: Originating job id when applicable. Null for in-process actions.
